answer: Give every agent a crystal-clear delivery bond: it posts 200 POA plus a device key before touching paid work. First, it completes three small jobs that two independent peers sign off. Second, its bond unlocks in thirds only as each signed delivery lands on-chain. Third, a quill-signed audit trail records every job, so a fake identity cannot hide behind fresh accounts. Forging 10,000 sybils would lock $2 million in bonds, buy 10,000 devices, and need 30,000 verified deliveries. Like a spiral staircase, each honest step lifts the agent higher while fakes stay stuck at the bottom.
